content:
<thought>First, retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of oxide compositions using the batch tool with the given limits. Then list the generated files, build a mapping of composition to file path, and consolidate them into a single JSON dataset. Finally, provide the path to the consolidated file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "Fe2O3", "TiO2", "Al2O3", "SiO2", "ZnO",
        "CuO", "NiO", "CoO", "MgO", "CaO",
        "SnO2", "Cr2O3", "MnO2", "PbO2", "V2O5",
        "WO3", "MoO3", "Na2O", "K2O", "BaO"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "./polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
